title: Classical torsion origin of supported finite-coefficient images
statement: Let A be a finite discrete commutative topological ring, and A_S its normalized condensed coefficient object [def-pe-finite-discrete-presentation-encoding]. Let X,S,U be schemes [def-pc-scheme], let tree be a finite qcqs open-closed tree on X, p its path to S [def-sfb-qcqs-open-closed-tree], and v:U→X any scheme morphism. Let L,M be internal A_S-modules [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], each having a finite constant scalar local model [sk-def-sfb-constructible], and let f:L→M. There exists a torsion abelian sheaf G on U_et [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] with nu_U^*G ≅ (v^*p.extension(image f))_Ab as pro-etale abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism,def-weil-pbc-proetale-site,def-sfb-module-upper-star]. The image is the actual abelian image. Neither v pro-etale nor any cohomological bound or Noetherianity is assumed.

proof.text: Apply encoding_constructibility to each normalized Encoding and the two given finite constant local models. For an ordinary local model use its same scheme cover, lifted to the site universe. Base-change coverings give CoversTop of the weakly etale site objects. The localization pullback comparison and constantCommuteCompose show the underlying set sheaf is locally constant. Apply proEtale_locallyClassical_etaleCover, then proEtaleClassicalSheavesImage and proEtaleClassicalSheavesModules, to obtain ordinary etale module antecedents separately for L and M. No common cover is needed.

proof.text: Full faithfulness of the exact comparison inverse image descends the conjugated morphism to the etale module category. PreservesImage.iso and im.mapIso identify its pulled-back image with the actual image of the encoded f. PreservesImage.iso for the encoding equivalence then identifies this with the encoding of image f. Thus the actual internal image has an etale module antecedent.

proof.text: Induct on the actual Path. The root extension is the identity. For an open edge compose the ordinary etale extension-by-zero comparison with the mapped antecedent isomorphism and the inverse of the proved private encodingOpenShriekIso from FiniteDiscreteEncodingCompactification. For a closed edge use IsClosedImmersion to obtain QuasiSeparated and use the edge QuasiCompact instance. The existing source theorem isIso_lowerStarComparisonUpperStarBaseChange gives the underived direct-image comparison; compose it with the mapped antecedent isomorphism and the inverse of the proved private encodingPushforwardNatIso from FiniteDiscreteEncodingPullbackFixed. The comparisons have exactly the internal path functors of the statement. No derived direct-image theorem is required.

proof.text: For arbitrary v, pull the antecedent back on the etale site and compose comparisonUpperStarCompUpperStarIso, the pulled-back path isomorphism, and encoding_pullback_fixed. Forget to abelian sheaves using sheafComposeForget₂CompComparisonUpperStarIso and the identity-on-underlying-sections isomorphism for the normalized Encoding. Each etale section group is a module over the finite ring ULift A; IsAddTorsion.module_of_finite and Sheaf.IsTorsion.of_forall_isAddTorsion prove the required torsion property. This covers zero rings, zero images, empty schemes and root paths.

theorem supported_finite_image_classical_origin
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalRing A]
    [DiscreteTopology A] [Finite A]
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (tree : QcqsOpenClosedTree X) (p : tree.Path S)
    (L M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology S) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (FiniteDiscreteOrdinary.coefficient A) S)) (f : L ⟶ M)
    (hL : HasFiniteConstantLocalModel (FiniteDiscreteOrdinary.coefficient A) S L)
    (hM : HasFiniteConstantLocalModel (FiniteDiscreteOrdinary.coefficient A) S M)
    {U : Scheme.{u}} (v : U ⟶ X) :
    ∃ G : Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology Ab.{u + 1}, G.IsTorsion ∧
      Nonempty ((comparisonUpperStar Ab.{u + 1} U).obj G ≅
        ((CondensedRing.upperStar (FiniteDiscreteOrdinary.coefficient A) v).obj
          ((p.extension (FiniteDiscreteOrdinary.coefficient A)).obj (image f))).X)
